name: results-export
description: The 'zone results' command controls which zone-related values are saved to exported results files. It is normally paired with 'model results export'.
default_behavior: Zone results are active by default.
Default exported values include stresses, groups, and displacements.
Use explicit keywords to include or exclude additional data families.

keywords.description: Control whether zone values are exported.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Include applied conditions at zones and zone faces.
keywords.name: apply

keywords.description: Include extra variables at zones and gridpoints.
keywords.name: extra

keywords.description: Include gridpoint unbalanced force information and local force ratio.
keywords.name: forces

keywords.description: Include group assignments to zones, faces, and gridpoints.
keywords.name: groups

keywords.description: Restrict exported zones by a saved range.
keywords.name: range

verification: The 19 keywords documented in this file are an EXACT match with the live FLAC3D 9.7 'zone results <bogus>' enumeration (no missing, no extra; 2026-08-13).
